title: ModelTurn
description: The structured output contract for every model turn: prose for the human, an optional patch for the machine. The client enforces this with OpenAI structured outputs (strict schema derived from this file — strict mode requires all keys present, so `patch` becomes nullable there) and retries up to 2x on validation failure with the validator error in-context. Free text never touches the tree.

say.description: Plain prose for the human. Never describes JSON.
